visual_description: Reconstructed Soviet columns cross the Finnish frontier at dawn; Finnish border landscape and period-correct equipment.
motion: Tracked camera follows a column moving through snow; exhaust drifts, soldiers move naturally, snow falls lightly.

visual_description: Original animated editorial map showing Finland, Leningrad, the Karelian Isthmus and the 1939 border.
motion: Map camera moves slowly from regional overview to the Isthmus; front line draws on screen.

narration_anchor: The Soviet invasion across multiple fronts
visual_description: Wide winter forest road with a historically plausible Soviet infantry column and period trucks.
motion: Low tracking shot alongside vehicles and marching infantry; exhaust and snow movement visible.

visual_description: Finnish reservists prepare winter clothing, skis and field equipment in a rural staging area.
motion: Close moving camera observes hands fastening equipment, soldiers mounting skis and departing.

visual_description: Aerial-style view of frozen lakes, dense forest, narrow roads and scattered settlements.
motion: Continuous drone-like glide over the landscape; wind moves tree branches and blowing snow.

visual_description: Winter road cut through forest with isolated Soviet vehicles and defensive positions in the distance.
motion: Camera advances along the road as distant figures move between cover; no graphic combat.

visual_description: Original top-down operational map showing road, separated formations, and Finnish blocking positions.
motion: Units and supply route animate in sequence; labels clarify encirclement without implying every pocket was destroyed.

narration_anchor: The human cost and winter conditions
visual_description: Finnish field medics and soldiers move a wounded comrade on a sled through snowy woodland.
motion: Handheld documentary-style follow shot; careful restrained movement, no graphic injury.

narration_anchor: The Mannerheim Line was not an impenetrable wall
visual_description: Period-accurate defensive earthworks, trenches, obstacles and modest concrete bunkers integrated into terrain.
motion: Slow lateral tracking shot reveals dispersed positions and snow-covered fieldworks.

visual_description: Soviet staff officers study maps and artillery tables in a field command post.
motion: Camera moves past map table as officers point, write and exchange documents; no invented readable orders.

visual_description: Soviet artillery positions fire toward distant Finnish defensive terrain; smoke and snow obscure horizon.
motion: Gun crews load and fire in controlled sequence; recoil and smoke behave plausibly, no close-up gore.

visual_description: Soviet infantry and tanks advance through a damaged defensive sector under winter haze.
motion: Camera tracks advancing infantry behind tanks; debris and smoke move naturally.

narration_anchor: Finland faces the decision to negotiate
visual_description: Finnish political leaders enter a government meeting building; use generic non-identifiable reconstruction unless verified likeness is essential.
motion: Exterior-to-interior tracking shot of officials entering, coats moving in winter wind.

visual_description: Close-up of period diplomatic papers, pen and winter light; do not fabricate legible treaty text.
motion: Slow push-in across paper as a hand turns a page; no invented signature.

visual_description: Finnish civilian families travel with belongings through a winter settlement; original map indicates cessions only after verification.
motion: Camera follows families walking along a snowy road; restrained, human-focused scene.

narration_anchor: What the war did and did not prove
visual_description: Quiet modern view of Finnish forest and memorial landscape, clearly identified as present-day if used.
motion: Natural wind through trees; slow steady camera move; no staged historical action.

visual_description: Wide winter landscape at dusk with a subtle transition to a verified map of postwar Finland.
motion: Slow forward glide through trees to open snowy landscape; dissolve to map.
